fields.description: Issue includes extensive editorial and political coverage ahead of the June 5, 1928 primary, criticizing local newspaper campaign reporting and discussing Florida races including governor, U.S. Senate, and Dade County offices (notably the sheriff’s race and the mechanics of second-choice voting). Also features local news and commentary on animal-cruelty concerns related to coursing at Hialeah, community entertainment and youth events (a juvenile movie contest at Roney Plaza pools), society and humor columns, and editorials on Dade County school finances and local manufacturing/industry.
relation: Published weekly at 815-16 Olympia Building, Miami, Florida, by Miami Life
Entered as second class matter, April 11, 1925, at the post office at Miami, Fla.
